note: Saudi Arabia: the other GCC states' citizens move freely; Russia's ordinary passports enter without a visa for 90 days in a calendar year since 11 May 2026 (the calendar-year count isn't modelled); British citizens may use the electronic visa waiver (single entry, up to 6 months); holders of the passports listed get a tourist e-Visa online or on arrival, for stays of up to 90 days. Everyone else needs a visa (holders of a used US, UK or Schengen visa may get the e-Visa on arrival: not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' and the Visit Saudi rules.

Citizens of the following countries may obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA) instead of a visa: United Kingdom The waiver can be used for single-entry with a maximum stay of 6 months. ...
